title: v67 ABS P3b screen plate + SfA interface | TPEI + glue

plates.name: v67 ABS P3b screen plate + SfA interface | TPEI + glue

desc: Black ABS, version 67. Textured PEI with glue. Back face down, solid (100 % zig-zag), no brim. Tree supports under the raised border with the Support for ABS interface (top Z distance 0, dense), two blockers over the peg pocket and the peg slot, prime tower behind the part. Slice in the window. Filament 1 black ABS on the main (left) nozzle, filament 2 Support for ABS on the auxiliary (right) nozzle from its external spool (D178). Shrinkage: your calibrated preset on filament 1.
